tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Lexiara's bounded EU and UK legislation corpus. Returns compact, citable results with opaque ids; pass an id unchanged to fetch for the provision text and provenance.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve one search result by its opaque id, including provision text, canonical URL, authority status and source provenance. Use ids returned by search without editing them.

tools.name: lookup_provision
tools.description: Authoritative text of one provision, with in-force window, repealed/prospective status, concept tags, transposition edges and full provenance. Use `asAt` (YYYY-MM-DD) for point-in-time law. Machine translation is not exposed through this connector because generating a new rendering is not a read-onl

tools.name: search_legislation
tools.description: Ranked full-text search over provision text. Results carry work, eId, status and provenance — feed a hit's work+eId to lookup_provision for the complete payload.

tools.name: provision_context
tools.description: The cross-reference neighbourhood of a provision plus its amendment history. tools.name: work_glossary
tools.description: The act's glossary: every term it defines, alphabetical, with the publisher's own wording verbatim and the provision that defines each one. tools.name: term_languages
tools.description: How an act words one of its defined terms in each language version held. tools.name: provisions_by_concept
tools.description: Cross-jurisdiction view of one legal concept: every provision tagged with the given EuroVoc concept, with tagging method and confidence. E.g. 'eurovoc:4585' (VAT), 'eurovoc:4392' (VAT rate). The language-neutral way to line up EU and national law on the same subject.

tools.name: related_works
tools.description: Edges between instruments: which national laws transpose a directive (direction 'in'), or what an instrument implements/amends (direction 'out'). Instrument-level; for article-level links use find_national_implementations.

Descriptions with editorialStatus='draft' are UNREVIEWED model drafts — say so if you quote one. Feed a result's conceptId to get_topic.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, search_legislation, list_topics, get_topic, list_review_queue, list_follows · Private data: lookup_provision, provision_context, define_term, work_glossary, work_mentions, provision_history, find_national_implementations, guidance_for_provision, list_follows · Public sink: list_follows · Destructive: list_follows.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, search_legislation, list_topics, get_topic, list_review_queue, list_follows · Private data: lookup_provision, provision_context, define_term, work_glossary, work_mentions, provision_history, find_national_implementations, guidance_for_provision, list_follows · Public sink: list_follows · Destructive: list_follows

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "provision_context" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
